source_scope: Application code matches e571dc3. Initial video/screenshots used Vite 8.3.2 and Undici 8.11.2; the final toolchain is patched to Vite 8.3.3 and Undici 8.12.2. Screenshot 10 and patched-runtime.json verify the patched app with the same persisted history.

capture.editing: Silent real browser capture segments; time between segments, restart downtime, and two transient narrow viewport frames omitted. No synthetic UI or altered application state in the images.

chapters.description: Dashboard: one exact action needs a human decision.
Project: deterministic fake provider; the run is paused for approval.
Exact action: delete the generated legacy_calc.py fixture. No attempt has occurred.
Action fingerprint and approval ID bind the decision to this exact request.
Confirmation: approval grants permission; it is not proof of execution.
Approve the exact generated fixture action, then wait for the worker.
The decision is recorded; execution is verified separately.
Execution succeeded in one recorded attempt. The timeline records dispatch, success, and resolution.
Run completed: implementation, five fixture tests, review, and the recorded human decision.
Progress remains in PostgreSQL; the browser is only a view.
After Ctrl+C and restart: the same project and completed run persist.
After restart: the same decision and successful execution remain, with one attempt.
Durable timeline: approved, dispatched, succeeded, resolved. One attempt after restart.
